text: Hi, I'm Bill Carter. I want to know how much it costs to replace a whole bathroom's plumbing.
Replacing a whole bathroom's plumbing requires an in-person assessment, but our standard diagnostic visit is $89. Would you like to schedule a technician to come take a look?
I don't want to book anything right now. Can't you just give me a rough price?
We don't have a flat rate for full bathroom re-piping since every job is different. The best option is an $89 diagnostic visit where a technician inspects the space and gives an exact quote.
Come on, surely you must have some ballpark figure. Is it closer to five hundred or five thousand?
I can't provide a ballpark estimate over the phone because costs vary depending on the scope. I can transfer you to our team during regular business hours if you'd like to discuss it further.
You're welcome. Have a great day!
